name: CN_SRP_ASGN_PROPOSALS
description: Table to store the proposals generated by Participant assignment rule engine for user action.

columns.name: PROPOSAL_ID
columns.description: System generated primary key.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: PARTICIPANT_OBJECT_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to Participant role table to identify the row to be updated or deleted

columns.name: ERROR_REASON_CODE
columns.description: This column holds the reason for the error in proposal.

columns.name: ERROR_REASON_TOKEN
columns.description: This column holds the tokens for the proposal error reason

columns.name: RECORD_TYPE
columns.description: Proposal aggregation type.

columns.name: PARTICIPANT_ID
columns.description: Participant Identifier. Foreign Key to CN_SRP_PARTICIPANTS_ALL.

columns.name: PARTICIPANT_DETAIL_ID
columns.description: Participant Detail  Identifier. Foreign Key to CN_SRP_PARTICIPANT_DETAILS_ALL.

columns.name: RULE_ID
columns.description: Rule  Identifier. Foreign Key to CN_RS_RULES_ALL_B.

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: ASSIGNED_OBJECT_ID
columns.description: Assigned object identifier. Foreign Key to CN_ROLES_B.

columns.name: ASSIGNED_OBJECT_TYPE
columns.description: Assigned object type identifier.

columns.name: START_DATE_ACTIVE
columns.description: Start date effective.

columns.name: END_DATE_ACTIVE
columns.description: End date effective.

columns.name: PROPOSAL_STATUS
columns.description: Status of the user action taken on the proposal, whether it is approved or rejected.

columns.name: PROCESS_STATUS
columns.description: Status of the proposal after it is submitted.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: MANUAL_CHANGE_FLAG
columns.description: Identifies where the data has been manually changed.

columns.name: PROPOSAL_TYPE
columns.description: Type of proposal, whether it is create, update or delete.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
